node.title: PMA rate-half two-petal support-fiber reduction
node.statement: After normalizing labels to (0,1,lambda), each exact core agreement set S determines a unique cofactor V_S by inversion modulo the second petal locator. A contributor exists exactly when deg V_S<=ell-a, the second residue Phi(S) modulo the third petal locator is the constant lambda, and V_S has no extra core root outside S. The reconstruction H_S=(L_SV_S-F_lambda)/(L_2L_3) is inverse to this map. Thus the fixed-cell list is exactly one guarded support-map fiber, with no separate missed-core or contributor-polynomial multiplier.
